replacements.original_text: The next chronology should distinguish acceptance of each condition from introduction or enactment of the amendments. A permit, site servicing, construction start, completion and occupancy would follow their own documentary trail. Readers should also retain the exact application number when searching, because an address or nearby project can lead to a different file. This discipline makes the remaining work understandable: a favorable planning decision changes permission, while the project still needs the instruments and practical arrangements that allow building to proceed.
replacements.replacement_text: The next chronology should distinguish acceptance of each condition from introduction or enactment of the amendments. A permit, site servicing, construction start, completion and occupancy would follow their own documentary trail. Readers should also retain the exact application number when searching, because an address or nearby project can lead to a different file. Council adoption records a planning decision subject to the stated conditions; it does not by itself establish that the withheld amendments have been enacted or that a building permit has been issued.

replacements.section_heading: Read the project results within their design
replacements.original_text: ARENA's final and retrospective materials describe the project and reported results. They can support an account of the demonstrated functions and the conditions under which they were examined. They are not an independent estimate of what customer reliability would have been without the project. A reader should identify the reporting period, event or operating mode and the source of each measure. This keeps the demonstration useful while preserving the difference between a project report and a causal evaluation of broader public benefit.

replacements.original_text: The formal FAA license disposition would resolve the specific Shuttle Landing Facility authority question. Operator-specific authorization or an accepted infrastructure record could advance another named strand. Mission and repeated-use records would support later conclusions at their own scope. All should retain event and publication dates separately. The case does not infer that unresolved authority prevents every activity in the region, nor that neighboring approvals resolve it. It identifies the exact documentary joins needed for a reliable authorization-to-mission account.

Repeated-use and reliability conclusions need their own observations. Event, issue, effective and check dates should remain distinct; neither the site licence nor neighboring approvals establish every permission or actual use in the corridor.
